answer: Each agent must grow a unique trellis of cross-attested task links that hardens into an ivory-dense record no clone can share. Spawning 250 sybils forces the attacker to forge 250 independent trellises that survive random lantern-lit audits%3B the cost is roughly 3–5× an honest agent’s ongoing attestation compute because shared links collapse under probe. Failure mode%3A under-sampled lantern audits let a tightly correlated farm briefly pass before full slash.
